about: M9 HELD-OUT key #2 (T19, D33 'try options' round, mole-builder-3), written and committed BEFORE any re-anchor run, similarity score (key measure) or new matcher option touched these pairs. Source: honojs/hono src/ TS/TSX history (not Mole, not Excalidraw, not hermes ui-tui). cases: every candidate pair produced mechanically by bench/m9-heldout2-builder.ts (a copy of bench/m9-heldout-builder.ts with only repo/prefix changed: same file, git -M renamed file, cross-file when token Jaccard >= 0.5), newest commits first. Each pair LABELLED BY HAND from the declarations, the commit diff lines naming the old/new symbol, and a whitespace/comment-insensitive text diff of the two declarations with the old name swapped for the new (a labelling aid, not the key similarity), with the same 3 labelRules as m9-key.json; every positive reason cites body or role continuity, not only switched callers. 'rename' needs identical declaration tokens except the own name, so a dropped 'private' modifier (private x -> #x) is rename+change.
labelRules: rename: same role, callers (if any) now use the new name, normalized body identical except the symbol's own name
rename+change: same role continued under a new name (callers switched, or the old code is the clear bulk of the new symbol) and the body was edited
not-rename: the old symbol was dropped, split across several new symbols, or merged with another into one generalized symbol (no single successor), or the bodies are too small to tell
stopRule: fixed before labelling, on label counts only: walk the src/ TS/TSX commits newest first from the pinned head and stop after the first commit at which the running count of expected re-anchors (rename + rename+change) reaches >= 20; every candidate pair of the commits walked so far is in the key

stop.note: walk = position in `git rev-list --no-merges <head> -- src/*.ts src/*.tsx`; all 1811 commits were generated (436 pairs); the pairs past walk 1023 were not labelled and are not in the key. 10 of the 21 positives come from one commit (walk 507: private x -> #x).

thresholds.similarity: Dice coefficient over token bigrams: TypeScript tokens of the declaration with trivia removed, the symbol's own name replaced by $SELF and (methods) its class name by $CLS

scoring: per old symbol: expected = its rename / rename+change pair if any, else none. right = re-anchored to the labelled symbol with the labelled outcome (rename -> renamed/fresh, rename+change -> renamed+changed/stale). wrong = re-anchored to any other symbol, or re-anchored when expected none. silentFresh = rename+change reported as renamed (fresh). Target: right >= 95% of expected re-anchors (held-out 2 cases), wrong = 0, silentFresh = 0. Band check (ruling 1 §5): count the old symbols whose best key candidate (labelled target for positives, best candidate for negatives) has key similarity in [0.40, 0.55); fewer than 5 = inconclusive.
